newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Trident Microsystems cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Trident Microsystems cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it downgraded Trident Microsystems Inc to neutral from outperform.
-- On Friday, Trident said it expects its fourth quarter sales and net income to be below expectations.
-- Lehman expects a slight rebound for Trident in the second half of the calendar year.
-- Believes price pressures will continue and will expand to the 3-D and the notebook market over the next several quarters.
-- Said visibility is poor for the quarter ending in September. Said ongoing price pressure and new entrants will continue to make multimedia a difficult market.
-- Cut fiscal 1998 estimates to $0.84 a share from $1.25 a share.
-- Cut the one-year price target to $11 from $15.
